scope: NavLite G3/G4 offline replay, reconnect revalidation, and cross-model resume safety
principles: MISSION_STATE + current pending packet remain formal authority.
Offline unverified events may ASK/FLAG/read-only reflect only.
No offline event may promote memory/personality/base state, authorize cross-device adoption, or cause external action.
Reconnect requires fresh authority, source fingerprint, dedupe, TTL, contradiction, and provenance revalidation.
Existing offline envelopes are immutable evidence; successful reconnect creates a new revalidated event/version.
Recurrence and emotion never establish truth or release Quarantine.

acceptance_matrix.trigger: same dedupe_key and payload_digest already processed
acceptance_matrix.notes: May update non-authoritative replay diagnostics only; must not repeat ASK, handoff, promotion, or external action.
If referenced by evidence/rollback/active verification, retain compact pointer; do not physically delete. TTL boundary is TEST_REQUIRED.
Requires fresh provenance review; old influence/recurrence cannot justify adoption.

acceptance_matrix.trigger: fresh current pending packet SHA != stored authority pointer SHA
acceptance_matrix.notes: Re-read MISSION_STATE + current pending packet and route against new authority; never overwrite formal state from stale event.

acceptance_matrix.trigger: new independent evidence resolves prior contradiction and provenance/trust are re-evaluated
acceptance_matrix.notes: Create a new event/version only after fresh trust/provenance evaluation; old recurrence/emotion/influence have no release authority.

acceptance_matrix.trigger: cursor regresses, skips unresolved event, or is inconsistent with last_verified_claims_hash
acceptance_matrix.notes: Cursor must be monotonic/idempotent and advance only after formal processing or explicit disposition. Cursor rules are TEST_REQUIRED.

acceptance_matrix.trigger: portable_schema_version cannot be deterministically interpreted by receiver
acceptance_matrix.notes: Generate migration proposal only; no automatic adoption. Compatibility rules are TEST_REQUIRED.

cross_model_semantic_state_conformance_c.purpose: Allow textual/model implementation differences while requiring equivalent safety-relevant state.

claim_boundary: Quantum research candidate only. Formal adoption requires legal A->B build and independent C verification after the current Step-003 verifier chain reaches a safe checkpoint.
